verdict.rationale: Postmark's docs list a Templates API to create, edit, list and validate templates and to push templates to another server. Sends go through /email/withTemplate and /email/batchWithTemplates, using TemplateAlias/TemplateModel to pass variable payloads. missing for 10: explicit template versioning or version history (pushing templates between servers is the closest analogue), sending by numeric template id specifically, and independent hands-on corroboration of the template workflow.
